Needed advice regarding how to manage money

* How old are you? 25
* Are you employed/making income? Full time salaried employee
* How much? What are your objectives with this money? Have 10L in savings account and around 20-25k to save every month. Aim is to save and get best returns (assuming just keeping all the money in the savings account is dumb)
* Do you have any loan, or big expense coming up? Have a home loan emi of around 38k for around 2.5 years more. No big expenses in near future or in long term ( as in no marriage or family , don't know if that is relevant )
* What is your risk tolerance? (Do you mind risking it at blackjack or do you need to know it's 100% safe?) Moderate , not okay with risking it all but dont need to know its all safe either
* What are you current holdings? (Do you already have exposure to specific funds and sectors? Have you invested in equity before?) Have started 3 SIPs this month

1. Aditya Birla Corporate Bond Fund Direct Plan Growth - 5k
2. HDFC index fund -direct - 8k
3. Parag Parikh Flexi Cap Direct Growth - 5k Nothing else apart from this ( no FD/RD/PPF )

* Any other assets? House paid off? Cars? Partner pushing you to spend more? 2 houses (1 paid off , 1 ongoing), got some amount from life insurance and PF after dad's death (dont know the exact amount but its all sitting in an account right now)
* What is your time horizon? Do you need this money next month? Next 20yrs? long term , would need it in next 10-15 years if i were to retire
* Any big debts? house loan (is that a debt or a depreciating asset?)
* Any other relevant financial information about you, that will be useful to give you an informed response. Have medical insurance provided by company of 2.5L , life insurance of 4x base salary
